story:
    id: divide-integers
    feature: calculator
    title: Divide integers
    as_a: Calculator User
    i_want: to divide two validated integers
    so_that: I can obtain their quotient or a zero-divisor error
    status: PLANNED
    acceptance_criteria:
        - id: 001-division
          description: The calculator must report "Cannot divide by zero" when dividing 6 by zero.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the dividend is "6"
                - the divisor is "0"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User divides the numbers
            - then:
                - the error is "Cannot divide by zero"
        - id: 002-division
          description: The calculator must report "Cannot divide by zero" when dividing 9 by zero.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the dividend is "9"
                - the divisor is "0"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User divides the numbers
            - then:
                - the error is "Cannot divide by zero"
        - id: 003-division
          description: The calculator must report "Cannot divide by zero" when dividing 0 by zero.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the dividend is "0"
                - the divisor is "0"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User divides the numbers
            - then:
                - the error is "Cannot divide by zero"
        - id: 004-division
          description: The calculator must print "3" as the quotient when dividing 6 by 2.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the dividend is "6"
                - the divisor is "2"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User divides the numbers
            - then:
                - the quotient is "3"
